text:
nina: FYI I opened PR #3422 to fix the /v1/uploads docs. The page shows a JSON body sample for file uploads and that causes users to get 415s. Our server expects multipart/form-data for binary files. PR switches main example to multipart and adds a short TS FormData snippet.

chao: nice, saw the stack trace in staging logs: `Unsupported Media Type` when calling with `-H 'Content-Type: application/json'`. Good to change the primary example.

build-bot: PR #3422 by nina: docs(upload): make multipart the canonical example; add browser/Node FormData snippet; add OpenAPI multipart/form-data entry; add migration note. (https://github.com/redwood-inference/docs/pull/3422) :white_check_mark:

frank: a few requests: 1) update the OpenAPI requestBody to include `multipart/form-data` with `file` (type: string, format: binary) and `purpose` (string, enum), 2) update the response example: runtime now returns `blob_key` and `size_bytes` (not `file_id`).

nina: agreed. Proposed minimal curl example: ```bash
curl -X POST "https://api.redwood.ai/v1/uploads" \
  -H "Authorization: Bearer $REDWOOD_API_KEY" \
  -F "file=@./sample.pdf" \
  -F "purpose=document_ingest"
```
I'll add a short Node/TS snippet using FormData that works in both browser and Node (using `form-data` when in Node). Also will include a small JSON example for remote-url uploads: { "url": "https://example.com/file.pdf", "purpose": "document_ingest" } and a clear note that JSON is only for remote fetches.

leah: for the TS snippet please add a warning: "Do not set Content-Type header manually when using FormData; let the client set the boundary." Also include sample console log showing `blob_key` and `size_bytes`.

frank: on the OpenAPI side I'll add `multipart/form-data` and keep `application/json` for the remote-url shape. I'll also add an explicit example object for the binary case so swagger-ui shows the fields. After patch I'll run `openapi-cli validate`.

chao: please add a small acceptance check to `docs/test/acceptance/uploads.md` that runs the curl example against local dev and asserts HTTP 2xx and presence of `blob_key` in response JSON. That should catch accidental regressions.

nina: good call. I'll add the changelog header at top: "2026-03-25: canonical uploads example changed to multipart/form-data; response `file_id` -> `blob_key`, `size_bytes` added." Also a short SDK migration note: "Replace `file_id` references with `blob_key` and read `size_bytes` if needed."

build-bot: Checklist for PR #3422: snippets added, openapi pending (frank), changelog & tests pending.

frank: pushed OpenAPI update; fixed an example indentation issue; `openapi-cli validate` passed.

leah: reviewed the markdown update; small nit on wording fixed.

chao: ran the acceptance test locally; curl sample returned 200 and `blob_key` present.

nina: merged. Thanks all. I'll follow up with a small note in the SDK migration guide and a one-line release note so integrations teams can be aware.

frank: will add a commit to SDK docs pointing to the new response shape.

nina: done. closing thread.
